probe.name: V2_alt_no_bs_per_bldg
probe.sql:
SELECT sum(ts_aggr."bs__out.electricity" * bs.weight) AS total_kwh,
       sum(ts_aggr._inner_rows) AS total_rows,
       count(DISTINCT (ts_aggr.bldg_id, ts_aggr.state)) AS distinct_bldg_state,
       count(DISTINCT ts_aggr.bldg_id) AS distinct_bldgs
FROM (
  SELECT ts_flat.state AS state, ts_flat.timestamp AS timestamp,
         ts_flat.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
         sum(ts_flat."ts__out.electricity") AS "bs__out.electricity",
         count(*) AS _inner_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state.state AS state, comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
           date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
           comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption" AS "ts__out.electricity"
    FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state
    WHERE comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state.upgrade IN (0) AND comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
  ) AS ts_flat
  GROUP BY ts_flat.state, ts_flat.timestamp, ts_flat.bldg_id
) AS ts_aggr
JOIN comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_national_parquet AS bs
  ON bs.bldg_id = ts_aggr.bldg_id
 AND bs."in.state" = ts_aggr.state
WHERE bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs."in.state" IN ('CO', 'NM')
